goal: Reach the Village era as fast as you can (it cannot come before day 3, about 17 minutes of game time); record the game time of every objective.

findings.title: Game runs at 4-11 ticks/s (1-2 fps) under shared load, making the Day 3 Village gate unreachable in a session
findings.detail: Throughout the session pt status/state showed tps 4-11 of 50 and fps 0-2 (host load average ~94 on 20 cores, so partly environmental). After ~23 min of wall clock the world was only at tick 7324 (day 1, timeOfDay 0.54). Village needs Day 3 (~tick 60000), i.e. 2-3 more hours of wall time. Every other Village condition except Members (7/10) was met by tick 6976 (~140 game s), so the day gate is the entire wait.
findings.repro: pt start --profile beyond-nations --game-dir /root/bn-wt-playtest064 --seed 102 on a busy host; pt status repeatedly

findings.title: Two-step build confirmation expires in ~40-48 game ticks, too short at low frame rates
findings.detail: Pressing K (or clicking Build House) shows 'Press K again / Click again to confirm: Build House', but the confirmation expired ('Not confirmed in time, so nothing was done.') five times in a row because a second press 8-15 s later was more than ~48 ticks at 4-6 tps. Only two clicks fired 3 s apart from one shell command worked. Build Stall, by contrast, built on the first click with no confirmation, which is inconsistent. Expected: a real-time window (or a longer one), and the same behaviour for all build buttons.
findings.repro: Inside own settlement with 20 wood/15 stone: pt key k; (wait ~10 s) pt key k -> 'Not confirmed in time'. Events ticks 6192-6672.

findings.title: Objective 7 progress text is clipped on the left and leaves out two of the four Village conditions
findings.detail: The objective bar reads 'nbers 7/10 · Buildings 2/2' (the 'Me' of Members is cut off). The objective tracks only Members and Buildings, but the era panel needs 4 conditions (Village 1/1, Members x/10, Stalls x/2, Day x/3). A player following only the objective will not know about the stalls or the day gate. Right after the second house the objective still said 'Buildings 1/2' while the era panel already said Village 1/1, until a later refresh.
findings.repro: Complete objective 6 (build a market stall), then click the Era '+' at (168,58) and compare the era list with the Objective panel

findings.title: Found-settlement refusal says 'open ground lies about 280 to the west' but nothing on screen shows direction
findings.detail: Pressing F too close to another town gives a useful message with distance and compass direction, but the HUD has no compass, map or heading, so the player has to guess which way is west. I only found it with the probe's yaw. The second attempt gave the same kind of message ('70 to the west') after a 255-unit walk.
findings.repro: Gather 50 wood near spawn (seed 102), pt key f at about (-146,-165) -> 'Too close to the Town of Fortressland... about 280 to the west'

findings.title: Objective hint and completion popups are truncated
findings.detail: Objective 4 hint showed 'Gather 50 wood, then press' with the key cut off (it wrapped correctly a few seconds later). The top toast read 'Objective complete: Create or' and the popup read 'Create or join a nat'. Expected: the full text, wrapped.
findings.repro: From a fresh world, gather 10 wood, then pt key n; screenshot right away

findings.title: Settlement world label renders huge across the top of the HUD, and pawn name labels overlap the objective panel
findings.detail: Right after founding, the floating label 'Village of Easternville / 3 here, 7/16 residents' is drawn in very large text behind the Chronicle and toast, and a pawn label ('...antha Brown') overlaps the Objective panel. Both are hard to read and clutter the HUD.
findings.repro: Found a settlement and stand next to it; take a screenshot

verdict: The early loop is quick and well guided: wood, nation, settlement and a stall took 95 game seconds, and the stockpile, the clear 'too close' message and the lively chronicle all helped. After that the Village era is just a wait on the Day 3 gate, which this overloaded host (about 6 tps) could not reach in the session. The objective panel also hides two of the four Village conditions (stalls and day). The two-step build confirm, which expires in game ticks, and the lack of a compass were the main frictions.
